items.text: The contract preserves the accessibility and engineering-review baseline, keeps the measurable contrast/readability target explicitly human-owned and TBD, separates diagnostic classes, preserves units and provenance, and makes no certification, compliance, or professional-approval claim.

verification.text: Validate the contract and review source parity, keyboard and labeling expectations, diagnostic and warning separation, unit/provenance visibility, protected-content boundaries, professional-boundary language, and every retained TBD or governed residual.
